under-construction.name: Under construction
under-construction.description: The Syretsko-Pecherska line's extension from Syrets to Mostytska and Varshavska, the only metro section being built in Kyiv; work resumed in November 2024 and the city expects both stations in 2027.

long-term.name: Long-term plan
long-term.description: The network of Kyiv's draft General Plan and the Kyiv Metro's development plans: the Podilsko-Vyhurivska line from Troieshchyna and Voskresenka across the Dnipro to Podil, the railway station and Zhuliany, the Vyshhorodsko-Darnytska line from the Minskyi masyv to Darnytsia, and extensions of the three existing lines. Where no official name exists, a station is named after its street or area.

kyiv-2070.name: Kyiv 2070
kyiv-2070.description: A concept for Kyiv's metro in 2070, not a city plan, grown from an unattributed concept map: the three lines extended, the Sviatoshynsko-Brovarska to Berkovetska and Bykivnia, the Obolonsko-Teremkivska to Odeska and Zhuliany, the Syretsko-Pecherska into Vynohradar; and nine new lines, among them a half-ring from Vynohradar past the airport and across the Darnytskyi Bridge to Darnytskyi Vokzal. The new lines' names are descriptive.
